cues: Gauss Seidel takes another route: iteration.
Solve each equation for its own unknown.
Start from a guess, nought, nought, nought, and keep improving.
It is guaranteed to converge when each diagonal coefficient beats the others in its row.
Here twenty beats one plus two, and so on.
